brand_personality: Sophisticated, quiet luxury, trustworthy, professional, modern, organized, high-end equestrian, operationally intelligent

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none text-[#F5F2EC] font-light
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight text-[#F5F2EC] font-light
rules.notes: E1 ANTI-DEFAULT RULE: Headings must use Cormorant Garamond to establish equestrian heritage. Body uses Inter for modern software clarity.

colors.rules: Avoid neon or bright saturations. All colors must remain matte and restrained. Backgrounds should feel deep and architectural.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous internal padding. Cards must use p-6 or p-8 to allow data to breathe.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Strict left-alignment for data and lists. Optical alignment for icons inside buttons.

cards.style: Rounded modern cards (rounded-2xl). Background bg-[#1E1E1E]. Border 1px solid border-[#4D4D4D]. Soft ambient shadow.
cards.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky headers and modals: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#111111]/70 border-b border-[#4D4D4D]/50.

buttons.primary: bg-[#BFC5CC] text-[#111111] font-medium rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 hover:bg-[#F5F2EC] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#4D4D4D] text-[#F5F2EC] rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 hover:bg-[#1E1E1E] transition-colors
buttons.quick_action: Large touch targets (min 44px height) for tablet usability in the barn.

navigation.sidebar: Dark matte sidebar (bg-[#111111]) with thin right border. Icons should be highly legible line-art. Selected state uses steel-blue (#52667A) subtle background with soft-ivory (#F5F2EC) text.

components.dividers: Hairline dividers (1px bg-[#2A2A2A]) used to segment lists without visual clutter.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Smooth and deliberate. transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out.
motion_and_interactions.microinteractions: Buttons scale down slightly on active (active:scale-95). Tabs slide indicator.

logo.description: EquineSync minimal luxury logo - ES monogram with horse head outline on black

login_background.description: Cinematic wide background of an immaculate luxury equestrian indoor riding arena at dawn

dashboard_hero.description: Elegant black horse portrait for empty states or dashboard welcome headers

barn_profile.description: Luxury horse barn interior for stable settings and facility overviews

media.rules: All images must be darkened or overlaid with black/50 when text is placed on top to maintain contrast and the moody luxury aesthetic.

iconography.style: Use thin stroke widths (strokeWidth={1.5}) to match the luxury minimalist aesthetic. Icons should feel like precision instruments.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lucide-react and configure Tailwind with the custom color palette provided.
Implement the 'Control Room Grid' for the dashboard with responsive adjustments for tablets.
Use 'Today's Barn Board' as the primary operational view with large touch-friendly cards.
Do NOT use pure white. Use the Soft Ivory and Light Silver for text.
Ensure all cards have a 1px #4D4D4D border and #1E1E1E background.
Override generic font families in Tailwind config: display uses Cormorant Garamond, sans uses Inter.
Never use placeholder image URLs. Rely entirely on the provided media URLs.
